bio.text: Marlón Durán is the Green Party candidate for Texas's 28th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
According to his campaign website, he was born in Mexico and his family settled in McAllen, Texas, when he was eight years old; he has lived in the Rio Grande Valley since.
The San Antonio Report reports that he has a degree in organizational leadership from South Texas College, has worked on local and federal campaigns, and works as a professional translator.
